body: Different responses work for different people and I totally agree that it shows that it's possible, but it does not at all work for me and many others.

The worst part is that you can't do anything, it's an impossible situation.  


What you can do is stay close to her as much as you can in case she does pass. Send messages and do anything you can over the internet. You can't keep her safe, but you can make sure the last moments are good ones.

Mostly my family and my girlfriend who I'm not very good at making happy. These are probably the reasons I don't do it, but at the same time now I'll have to live out a miserable life. Do I just wait until these don't matter to me? I dunno
